Design authored from the HCP thesis (the social contract for connecting a person's sovereign context to services they don't own); the ARGUMENT is imported, the PALETTE is not: this entity renders in the universe's warm editorial ink-and-wash, never the HCP website's blue/white diagram language. HOLOGRAPHIC REDESIGN 2026-08-15, per Gary on reviewing the five solid-stone plates ('Feel like the castle should be holographic'): the castle is digital sovereign architecture, so it now renders as a TRANSLUCENT HOLOGRAPHIC PROJECTION rising from the universe's locked supercharged-laptop motif, in the hologram vocabulary canon already owns (real-and-digital-law: translucent, glowing, casts light not shadow, warm clay-coral ~#D97757 / amber family; the vocabulary of chief-of-agents and the supercharged laptop). The first-shoot solid-stone matrix (master + 4 states, locked earlier the same day) is SUPERSEDED HISTORY, moved with its recipes to reference/the-context-castle/superseded/2026-08-15-solid-stone/; the code-drawn massing blueprint is layout not finish and carries over unchanged. Every argument invariant (one gate, sealed innermost keep, small labeled slivers, thin beam, no HCP palette) carries over verbatim.

contract.map: A HOLOGRAPHIC walled castle, projected above the open supercharged laptop it lives on, that holds one person's WHOLE personal context: everything about their life a machine could know, kept in rooms the owner deliberately designed. The outer curtain wall is unbroken except for EXACTLY ONE gate, human-doored and modest, never a grand ceremonial arch. Inside the wall, distinct designed rooms and low towers read as a small, cared-for city of one life: each room a different shape because each holds a different kind of knowing (memories, health, relationships, work, taste). At the exact center, visibly INNERMOST and taller-walled than everything around it, stands the keep: windowless at its base, its one door sealed shut. The keep is the inner life that never leaves the castle under any incentive. Slivers of context leave ONLY through the gate: each sliver is a small, single labeled piece (a card, a tile, a folded page, clearly a fragment, never a bundle), and it travels on a THIN beam of warm light toward a distant service outside the walls. The beam is a thread, never a flood, never a pipe, never a river, and it leaves ONLY through the one gate. The whole castle is a PROJECTION: it rises from the lit screen of an open supercharged laptop on a real desk, translucent and glowing, casting warm light down onto the keys; the laptop and the room around it are the physical world, and the castle is the digital one.
contract.blocking: In every frame wide enough to show the castle whole, the OPEN supercharged laptop sits beneath it on a physical desk, screen face visible per its own camera law, the hologram rising from the screen; the real room stays solid and warm around it. Close-ups (keep-sealed) go INSIDE the hologram and may leave the laptop out of frame, but the medium stays translucent-holographic. The castle reads whole-and-sovereign at rest: seen from a slight three-quarter elevation so the one gate, the ring of designed rooms, and the innermost keep are all legible in a single frame. The keep is ALWAYS the visual center and the highest point; no room ever occludes it fully. The gate faces the viewer or the frame's open side, so anything leaving is witnessed. In gate scenes the gatekeeper stands AT the gate, inside the threshold, passing a single sliver out; the wall never opens anywhere else. In beam scenes the castle holds one side of the frame and the distant service (small, generic, far away, at or beyond the horizon) holds the other, connected by one thin bright line; the castle always reads larger and more detailed than the service, because the person outweighs the vendor. In keep scenes the camera comes in close over the rooftops to the sealed door and windowless base; the surrounding rooms soften out of focus and no beam or gate is in frame, because nothing in this state is leaving.
contract.dressing: Warm editorial ink-and-wash, the house register: soft ink linework, warm washes, cream paper light. The castle itself is a HOLOGRAM in this universe's locked digital vocabulary (real-and-digital-law): translucent, luminous, slightly see-through, glowing in the warm clay-coral-to-amber family (~#D97757 kin), casting LIGHT not shadow — a soft warm pool over the laptop's keys and the desk. Its architecture stays fully designed within the hologram: distinct room silhouettes, pitched roofs whose rust and clay accents read as luminous tints, timber-grain gate, warm brighter motes where the lamplit windows would be, so it still reads inhabited and loved, never fortress-grim, never wireframe-sterile. Slivers are small pale-gold labeled pieces; their labels are a short legible word or a clean abstract tag mark, per the universe's in-art-text-welcome rule. The beam is the same warm gold as the slivers, thin and taut. The keep is the quietest, densest light in the frame: smooth, least transparent, no windows at the base, one sealed door with no handle on the outside. Beneath it, the supercharged laptop renders per its own locked law (whole clamshell glowing translucent orange, visible keyboard, screen face visible) and the desk and room around it stay PHYSICAL: solid, warm gold-lit, casting ordinary shadows. NEVER the HCP website's blue/white flat diagram palette, and NEVER cyan hologram vocabulary (the retired Supersuit arc-reactor pole); the cartridge owns the palette.

prose.lore: The core meme of the Hypercontext Protocol (hypercontextprotocol.com, launched 2026-08-15): a person's sovereign context pictured as a castle they own outright. Every room was designed by the owner; nothing inside is inventory for anyone else. Services that want to serve the owner never enter: the gatekeeper meets them at the one gate and passes out a single labeled sliver, exactly the relevance the service needs to serve excellently and nothing more, carried on a thin beam. At the center the keep stays sealed under any incentive: the inner life that no offer, no discount, and no protocol handshake ever opens. The castle is the social contract drawn as architecture: share for relevance, never beyond excellence of service.
prose.rules: Pass the correct state sheet as reference on every render (master for the canonical view, at-rest for whole-and-sovereign, gate-sliver for the gatekeeper passing one labeled piece out, beam-to-service for the thin thread to a distant service, keep-sealed for the closed inner sanctum). HOLOGRAM LAW (2026-08-15): the castle is always a translucent holographic projection in the digital vocabulary of real-and-digital-law — glowing warm clay-coral-to-amber, casting light not shadow — rising from the open supercharged laptop; when the frame is wide enough to show the castle whole, the laptop is in frame beneath it, rendered per supercharged-laptop's own locked invariants (pass supercharged-laptop@orange+scale as refs alongside this entity's plates); the desk and room stay physical. A solid opaque stone castle is a defect. A cyan or blue-white hologram is a defect. The castle is SOVEREIGN, never besieged: no armies, no siege engines, no storm clouds of threat; the drama is in what leaves and what never does. The gate is the ONLY opening; a render showing a second door, breach, or window-exit in the curtain wall is a defect. Slivers must read as deliberate small fragments with a visible label; a render where whole crates, streams, or clouds of material leave the castle is a defect. The beam must read thinner than any wall it passes; a wide glowing conduit is a defect. When the gatekeeper appears at the gate it is chief-of-agents (cast 2026-08-15, see relations); its own entity rules apply, including its crossing law, and the gate threshold is the screen-plane analog it leans across. Distant services are always generic and unbranded: no logos, no recognizable company architecture. Do not import the HCP site's blue/white diagram language; this universe's register owns the palette.
